summary: Sanity-grep finalization in code-research.md is complete and internally consistent. All 6 pre-flight token-replace hits (DRAG_ANALYSIS:37; WEB_RESEARCH:45/64/132; CONCURRENT_WRITERS:157/217) are documented with explicit before/after originals, replacements, and replace-token verdicts in §4.3. Closing 'Sanity-grep run completed 2026-04-27' paragraph is present. The re-run discovered 3 additional hits in recovered/competitive-landscape/README.md (lines 8-10) that are upstream narrative about the validation work itself — correctly classified as keep with rationale, and noted that the docs/ promotion of that index will be a separate owner-driven rewrite during Task 4. Cross-check against core/ + mcp/ confirms zero hits and properly disambiguates the unrelated sha384 Arweave deep-hash function. Acceptance criteria verified: grep -c 'replace-token' = 8 (>=6), grep -c 'Sanity-grep run completed' = 1, all 6 pre-flight hits documented with verdict column, no new stale terms appended (none surfaced — explicitly justified). Frontmatter status flipped to done with teammate_name populated. Single commit matches the prescribed message.

findings.issue: Sentence 'No `keep` verdicts on stale-content lines.' is technically accurate (the 3 README keeps are narrative, not stale-content) but reads as contradictory next to §4.2 which explicitly assigns `keep` verdicts to those 3 README lines. A reader scanning only §4.3's closing remarks could misread this.
findings.suggestion: Optional: tighten to 'No `keep` verdicts on stale-content lines (the 3 narrative `keep`s in §4.2 are upstream meta-commentary about the replacement work, not stale claims).' Non-blocking — current text is defensible given the §4.2 elaboration.

findings.issue: DRAG_ANALYSIS:37 verdict is labeled `replace-token` (delete-line variant) while §4.1 of the user-spec characterises this hit as a delete-line. Task 2 description and tech-spec Decision 3 use the unified `replace-token` umbrella — naming is consistent here, but a future reader checking the user-spec table at lines 71-73 may notice the user-spec uses '(SHA3 hash)' → удаление as a separate category from token replacements.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add a one-line note that 'replace-token' covers the full override family (line-delete, token-delete, token-substitute) per Decision 3. Non-blocking — Decision 3 already defines this and is referenced in §4.1.
